avis.texte: The texture on this Korean cream is so lightweight but very moisturizing, not greasy at all, I been using this in the AM/PM for the past week, and since this is a brightening cream, I have notice that some of my dark spots circles have appear lighther and my skin us very hydrated. Definitely great product to add to my routine.

This cream gives my face good hydration and leaves me with a dewy look. I've only been using it for 1 week so I'm not sure about the long term effects but I like how my skin looks and feels when I use it. You can't go wrong with any Korean products, I'll die on that hill, I love all their products.

I've been using the CELIMAX Pore+Dark Spot Brightening Cream for several months, even before this 2-week event, so I already knew it worked well for my skin. It has helped improve the appearance of my dark spots and uneven skin tone, leaving my skin looking brighter, smoother, and more even. I love that it feels lightweight and hydrating without being greasy. The combination of Tranexamic Acid, Niacinamide, and Melazero V2 is a great bonus for targeting pigmentation and dark spots.

avis.titre: I love the consistency of this cream
avis.texte: I really liked the texture of this cream. I use it as my final step of my routine over toner and serums and it applies very nicely and seals everything in. It's lightweight and absorbs well. I haven't had any allergic reactions or breakouts since using it. I would highly recommend it for anyone who has oily to normal skin as the texture is light enough to still feel hydrated without feeling heavy and greasy.

I've been using the Celimax Pore + Dark Spot Brightening Cream for two weeks, and I'm really impressed with it. My skin looks brighter, more even-toned, and smoother, and I've noticed my dark spots appear less noticeable. I also love that it leaves my skin feeling hydrated without feeling heavy or greasy. It has been a great addition to my skincare routine, and I'm definitely happy with the results so far!

I really like this cream! I use it as the step in my skincare routine, both morning and night. I have oily and sensitive skin, and this dark spot brightening cream is super lightweight and isn't pore clogging so it hasn't irritated my skin at all. It also doesn't make my makeup pill which is a huge plus. I've been using it for about two weeks now and feel that it has helped my acne scares brighten a bit. I will say that consistency is key to see results. When choosing a cream like this, ingredients matter as well.

avis.titre: Lightweight, hydrating cream backed by science
avis.texte: I wanted this cream because of its formulation with multiple ingredients that target dark spots. In the past, I've tried several dark spot targeting treatments from other brands but have not been able to use them consistently due to getting breakouts or the formulas dehydrating my skin. After using this cream for several days, I really like it compared to others. It's very moisturizing and is surprisingly lightweight. I haven't been using it long enough to notice a discernable difference in larger dark spots, but it has tighened the pores around my nose! This cream is a great addition to any skincare routine. Works well with other serums and doesn't peel under sunscreen.

My skin is very tan (NW 35 range for reference). I have stubborn, dark acne scars that refuse to fade for many years. I found out about tranexamic acid for dark spots and had tried various serums and creams with no real results. This was recommended by a Korean dermatologist who I follow on social media and who's recommendations tend to be in line with my K-beauty product experiences. I noticed a slight lightening effect after about two weeks. It's been a month now and I am on my second tube! My scars are very dark so I already know it'll take perhaps 3 or 4 tubes total. However, I would think others with less color differences between their skin and their dark spots wouldn't need more than one tube.

Dark spots and hyperpigmentation is something I've always had trouble with. After getting a pimple, I feel like the dark spot that it leaves takes months for it to finally clear up. I've only used this product for a couple days, so obviously I won't see results right away, but I do think there is potential in this product. The product itself has no scent and it doesn't leave a sticky feeling. One cool thing is that it's advertised as a product where you can apply a thick layer as a sleeping pack, so I'll definitely try that out. Overall, the product seems to be working with my skin well and I'm excited to see how the product will eventually affect my skin!

I have combination skin and have been using the Celimax pore + dark spot brightening cream consistently for about a week now, applying it morning and night right after my serum. It provides great moisture for my drier areas without making my T-zone feel greasy or heavy, and it's completely non-drying. Even in this short amount of time, I've already noticed a slight fading of the dark spots under my eyes and around my lips. I'm giving it 4/5 stars only because it's still early, but the initial results and texture are very promising. I'm excited to see the long-term progress!

avis.titre: Helped so much with my hyperpigmentation
avis.texte: I've struggled with stubborn dark spots for a long time, and this cream caught my attention after I kept seeing it all over social media. I'm pretty realistic when it comes to skincare, so I didn't expect any product to completely transform my skin within just two or three weeks. I wanted to give it a fair chance, so I used it consistently every day for the past three to four months. I've honestly been loving it! With regular use, I noticed that my overall complexion looked brighter and my dark spots gradually became less noticeable. The results didn't happen overnight, but I could definitely see a difference over time. Consistency is key with this product. Don't expect dramatic results after only one or two uses. Give it time and make it part of your daily routine. If you stick with it, you may start to notice real improvement!
It seems like dark spots fade when you have it on your face, but after you wash your face dark spots come back. I am on my second one and it is my last.

This is a great moisturizer that helps brighten skin gently. I had transitioned over to the Celimax skincare due to my time restraints with nursing school. My previous daily skin routine utilized very high end products, and was condensed from 8 steps to 3, with my alternating night routine condensed from 8 steps to 4. It took me 2 weeks to completely transition over to Celimax, and I have been using this new skincare routine for the last month. I am very happy with the results, especially at the price point. This is a gentle brightening cream that provides my skin with even tone, without a greasy residue. I have combination-oily skin, and proned to clogged pores and blemish, especially when I am stressed or do not get enough sleep. My Daily Routine: I use the Dual Barrier Creamy Toner, then the Brightening Serum, followed by the Brightening Cream (all from Celimax). I always complete my skincare routine with a sunscreen (not Celimax because I have a buttload of my current one I want to use up first). I find that my skin remains hydrated throughout the day, and there is a healthy radiance in my skin without a greasy residue. I am able to complete my makeup routine without any pilling or issues. I have even stopped wearing foundation, and am able to wear a tinted moisturizer due to my even complexion. I have not noticed any drastic changes with my pores, they are naturally large. Brightening Cream: This is a gentle, daily skin brightening moisturizer that helps keep my skin moi

avis.titre: use it correctly and it works !
avis.texte: i was using it before my moisturizer but you must must MUST ! apply it last! i suddenly noticed a drastic appearance in my dark spots from acne !!! wish i knew sooner LOL im buying another once i finish my first one. wouldnt say it did too much for my pores though. i like it.
Absolutely a waste of money. Did nothing for my pores or dark spots.
Didnt notice any difference. Skin felt moisturized but thats about it. I give it 2 stars.
This has been great for dark spots! really gentle on my sensitive skin and a little does a long way. I would definitely recommend this product.

I started noticing i was developing like a 5 oclock shadow on my upper lip. It wasnt hair but my own skin. I did some digging turns out it was getting hyperpigmentation most likely from my birth control. Ill probably still try to use it for my pores and undereyes. But i wouldnt buy this product again.

I really love this cream. It features a perfect blend of ingredients at proven, effective concentrations, yet it remains completely non-irritating. The texture is lightweight but still deeply moisturizing, and it wears beautifully under sunscreen. I was originally intrigued because it contains Melazero—an ingredient that's been on my radar for a while. I'm extremely happy with the results and would happily repurchase it!

Went in looking for Korean skincare for dark spots. Luckily, I found this display in the checkout line and immediately caught my eye! So glad I gave this a shot. It's incredible. I've been using it for about two days now and have noticed instant results! Works as a moisturizer, while effectively helping fade my hormonal acne scars.

I suffer from hormonal acne scars and hyperpigmentation along my jawline and this brightening cream has helped significantly. Its not to harsh(as I have sensitive skin) and didnt cause my skin to dry out. If you are lookibg for something gentle yet effective, I highly recommend.
